purpose: Prototype v6m: counts asked for by the pre-review of outline v9 for the Journal of Writing Research (round 3) and decided by the researcher (decisions 14-16 of .steering/20261108-paper-a-jowr-reframe; decisions 1-4 of .steering/20261108-v6m-real-contrast-and-dose). (0) v6k's rule recounted on persons not used before, under v6k's gate R and under R_loc (round 3, point F: no earlier count of the same summaries on other persons existed, so 'replication' was too strong). (1) A real difference instead of an operation: the same KUPA person's copy task against their essay, read as the 'operation', with R_loc as the gate: do U, B, Bsd and I show the difference beyond the person's own variation in the copy and in the essay? (2) Doses of two operations, 25%, 50% and 100%: the move of sentence-initial gaps into the same sentence (a partial inside), and the move of long sentence-initial gaps into another sentence (a partial cross): how much must move before each summary and the reference show it (round 3, R2: all or nothing; Codex: a sensitivity curve)? (3) U's two medians alone (U_med), leaving out the two IQRs of low split-half reliability in v6l (0.16-0.37). (4) Signed changes at the level of the group: per feature, the median over persons of the change and the shares of its signs (round 3, R1 N4: count 1 is a judgement per person, not a comparison of conditions at the level of the group).
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-11-08 after seeing the records and notes of v6k and v6l (results/prototype_v6k/, results/prototype_v6l/, including the erratum of v6l's notes) and the pre-review of outline v9 (round 3). No value of any stage has been computed for the persons drawn here: KUPA from position 656 of v6's draw order (positions 0-655 were looked at by v6, v6b and v6k), LWP from position 411 of v6e's (0-410 by v6e and v6k). No value of the real contrast, of a dose row, of U_med or of a signed change has been computed for any person of any dataset. A first draft was sent to Codex (codex-consult, the conditions text and earlier aggregate results only, no data; .steering/20261108-v6m-real-contrast-and-dose/codex-consult-output.md) and changed after its seven points (decision 5 of that folder): the shares of cells fixed by construction follow v6k's tie rule; a paired comparison of each stage with R_loc on the same persons is added; the scale of part 1 is fixed once per cell and a within-task scale and an all-pairs change are added beside; the generators of the dose rows are fixed (one plan per person, the doses its prefixes); the doses are reported by what actually moved; the signed changes are read by the shares of their signs first.
status: Parts 0 and 1 have rules fixed here before any value is seen, counted on persons not used before: a confirmation in this sense (status c), with a procedure, rows and gate chosen on earlier persons (v6-v6l). Parts 2, 3 and 4 are descriptions (status d) with their reading fixed here.

sources.v6k: works/conditions/prototype_v6k.json and results/prototype_v6k/record.json (SHA-256 in earlier): the stages, rows, operations, keys, count 1 and the rule of part 1.
sources.v6l: works/conditions/prototype_v6l.json and results/prototype_v6l/record.json: R_loc, R_lag, B_complete and the split-half reliabilities that motivate U_med.
sources.van_waes_2021: copying mainly measures typing skill ([13] of references.md, Van Waes et al. 2021): a limit of part 1.

data: KUPA-KEYS TASK-1 (copy) and TASK-2 (essay) as v6's conditions; LWP as v6e's conditions (files and SHA-256 there). Kinds as v6b's kind_b (KUPA) and v6e's (LWP); sentence and word starts and the gap labels (sentence, subsentence, word, within, other) as v6b.labels.

participants.kupa: the ids of TASK-2 sorted, in v6's draw order (v6.draw_order(..., 0)); positions 0-655 are skipped; from position 656 on, the first 200 ids eligible under v6b's rule (as v6k). The run checks that positions 0-216, 217-436 and 437-655 give exactly v6's, v6b's and v6k's persons (their SHA-256; v6k looked at 219 ids from 437) and that the new persons overlap none.
participants.lwp: the ids of train_logs.csv in v6e's draw order (v6.draw_order(..., 2)); positions 0-410 are skipped (0-203 v6e's, 204-410 v6k's, checked as above; v6k looked at 207 ids from 204); from position 411 on, the first 200 ids eligible under v6e's rule.
participants.too_few: if fewer than 200 eligible ids remain, the run stops (no smaller set is counted).
participants.count_1_persons: per dataset and task, v6k's: at least 8 sentences and at least one held gap in every part under both baselines (k6.count1_ok); the numbers left out are recorded.
participants.contrast_persons: KUPA persons who are count 1 persons in both tasks; for a stage, those with its vector in all four parts (copy A and B, essay A and B) under the baseline; for part 1's rule, those with the stage and R_loc in all four parts (contrast rule persons). Numbers recorded per stage and baseline.

units_parts: as v6k: sentences (cut at the sentence-end keys; the gap before a sentence counted in it, counting 'before', unless a row says otherwise); parts odd/even and halves (v6b.parts). One fixed threshold, 2000 ms (long if g >= 2000 - 1e-6 ms). The other thresholds and the writer's thresholds of v6k and v6l are not counted.

stages.reused: S0, S1, U@2000, B@2000, Bsd@2000, I, R, Bsd_complete@2000 exactly as v6k; R_loc, R_lag, B_complete@2000 exactly as v6l (v6k's and v6l's code, imported).
stages.U_med: the two medians of U@2000 (median over the part's sentences of u_speed and of u_rest; U's first and third numbers): 2 numbers. A part has U_med exactly when it has U@2000.
stages.by_construction: stated before running and checked per person in the run (a violation stops it): under inside_25, inside_50 and inside_100 each sentence keeps its multiset of gaps, so the changes of U@2000, U_med, S1 and B@2000 (each run keeps its multiset) and of I's first number are 0 (as v6k's inside/before). These cells are 'fixed by construction': their shares are computed by v6k's rule (a change of 0 against a base above 0 counts 0, against a base of 0 counts 1/2), reported with the number of zero bases, and not read. No identity is claimed for the cross rows or the contrast.

rows.v6k_rows: text/before, text/after, text/none, inside/before, shuffled/before, shuffled_in_halves/before, random_half, with v6k's operations and keys (k6.row_times; key [dataset, task, place], place the index of the id in the sorted ids).
rows.inside_p: for p in 0.25, 0.50, 1.00 (rows inside_25, inside_50, inside_100): the candidates are the sentences other than the first that hold a word start after their first press (rests_inside_at's sentences; m of them). One plan per person and record, made once from the text: the swap partners are drawn exactly as rests_inside_at draws them (one generator numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 6, 5, dataset, task, place]), advanced by one integers call per candidate, candidates in sentence order, sentences without a later word start drawing nothing); the candidates' order is numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 94, 1, dataset, task, place]).permutation(m) (no call if m = 0). Dose p applies the swaps of the first ceil(p m) candidates of that order (the gap before the sentence's first press with the gap before its drawn word start); the others are left. So inside_25 is a prefix of inside_50 and inside_50 of inside_100, and inside_100 equals v6k's inside/before (checked per person: equal gaps). Every sentence-initial gap of a chosen sentence moves, long or short.
rows.cross_p: for p in 0.25, 0.50, 1.00 (rows cross_25, cross_50, cross_100): one plan per person and record, made once from the text's gaps. Givers are the sentence-initial gaps (the gap before the first press of each sentence but the first) that are long (>= 2000 - 1e-6 ms); m of them. The pool is the gaps before a word start strictly after its sentence's first press (any sentence, the first included) that are short (< 2000 - 1e-6 ms), fixed from the text before any swap. The givers' order is numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 94, 2, dataset, task, place]).permutation(m) (no call if m = 0). One generator numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 94, 3, dataset, task, place]) is made once and, for each giver in that order (all m, whatever p), the eligible set is the pool gaps not yet taken and not in the giver's own sentence, in increasing gap index; if it is empty the giver gets no partner and no draw is made (counted), otherwise one integers(size of the set) call picks the partner, which is taken. Dose p applies the swaps of the first ceil(p m) givers of the plan (a giver without a partner stays). So cross_25's swaps are a prefix of cross_50's and those of cross_100's (checked per person). A person with m = 0 has the rows equal to the text (counted). The long gap leaves the sentence boundary and lands inside another sentence; the receiving and giving sentences and parts change their multisets, so U, B and I can change.
rows.only_press_times: only the press times are rebuilt; kinds, starts and labels stay with the presses (so a moved long gap carries the label of its new place).
rows.row_index: as v6k (text/before 0, text/after 1, text/none 2, inside 3, shuffled 4, shuffled_in_halves 5, random_half 6), then inside_25 7, inside_50 8, inside_100 9, cross_25 10, cross_50 11, cross_100 12.
rows.tallies: per dataset and task over count 1 persons, per dose row: five-number summaries of m, of the swaps made, of the share of candidates swapped, of the time moved (for cross the sum of the moved long gaps over the record's total time; for inside the sum over swaps of |difference of the two gaps| over the total time) and, per baseline, of the swaps that cross a part's boundary (giver and partner in different parts); the givers left without a partner; the persons with m = 0; the persons for whom two steps apply the same swaps (ceil makes them equal for small m).

count_1.how: v6k's count 1 (v6b.one: share of persons whose change exceeds the distance between their own two parts, ties 1/2, with a 95% percentile interval over 2000 bootstrap resamples; the same against the median distance to another person; medians) for KUPA essay and LWP, both baselines, every row and every stage (S0, S1, U@2000, U_med, B@2000, Bsd@2000, I, R, R_loc, R_lag, B_complete@2000, Bsd_complete@2000), on all persons with the stage (gate 0), and on rule persons (the stage and R both present, as v6k) for the rule stages and B_complete, U_med and Bsd_complete in the main rows and the dose rows, with the stage, R, R_loc and R_lag counted on those persons. KUPA copy: only its text vectors are used (part 1).
count_1.keys: numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 95, dataset, task, stage, row index, baseline, 0, gate]) with v6l's stage indices (S0 0, S1 1, U 2, B 3, Bsd 4, I 5, R 6, Bsd_complete 7, R_loc 8, R_lag 9, B_complete 10) and U_med 11; gate 0 on all persons, 1 + the stage index of the rule stage for its rule persons (the same for its R, R_loc and R_lag). (v6k's and v6l's keys start with 90; 95 keeps the new persons' draws apart.)

part_0_rule_on_new_persons.rule: v6k's part 1 rule unchanged (12 main cells: KUPA essay and LWP; odd/even and halves; inside/before, shuffled/before, shuffled_in_halves/before; at 2 s; on rule persons; the cells fixed by construction; R above 0.60 as the gate; the six labels; at least 4 evaluable changeable cells) for U@2000, B@2000, Bsd@2000 and I, under gate R (v6k's) and under gate R_loc (v6l's form). Reported as v6k's and v6l's: labels, classes by dataset and row, statuses, persons left out, and the per-cell kinds (location only, order only, both, composite only, not seen). Beside: U_med, B_complete and Bsd_complete in the same cells under both gates, no label.
part_0_rule_on_new_persons.reading: a label equal to v6k's on these persons is 'the label held on persons not used before under the same committed rule'; a different label is reported as different, with the cells that changed. This is the only part that can be called a replication of v6k.

part_1_real_contrast.what: per KUPA contrast person, baseline and stage, from the text vectors (text/before) of each task's two parts. Scale (main, 'pooled'): each feature divided by its standard deviation (ddof 0) over the persons of the cell and their four parts (copy A, copy B, essay A, essay B), computed once per cell and kept fixed across bootstrap resamples (the interval is conditional on it, as v6k's); a feature of standard deviation 0 is dropped (recorded; all dropped stops the run). change = (|essay A - copy A| + |essay B - copy B|) / 2 (Euclidean on the scaled features; A with A and B with B as v6k pairs the parts of a row with those of the text); base_copy = |copy A - copy B|; base_essay = |essay A - essay B|. share_vs_own = the share of persons whose change exceeds the base (ties 1/2), with a 95% percentile interval over 2000 bootstrap resamples of persons; medians of change and base and of their ratio where the base is above 0; the zero bases.
part_1_real_contrast.cells: 4 per stage: odd/even and halves, each against base_copy and against base_essay.
part_1_real_contrast.keys: numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 96, stage index, baseline, base, gate]) with base copy 0, essay 1; gate 0 for a stage on its own contrast persons, and 1 + the stage index for the stage and its gates on the contrast rule persons; the beside counts and the paired difference reuse the cell's indices.
part_1_real_contrast.stages: U@2000, B@2000, Bsd@2000 and I (labelled); U_med, B_complete@2000, Bsd_complete@2000, S0, R, R_loc and R_lag (beside, no label).
part_1_real_contrast.rule: fixed before running. On the contrast rule persons of each labelled stage, a cell is evaluable only if R_loc reads it above 0.60 there (lower end of its interval above 0.60); otherwise 'control not met' and not read. v6k's six labels over the evaluable cells; fewer than 4: 'not evaluable' (so a label needs all 4 cells). Reported beside: R's class in the same cells, and the classes by base.
part_1_real_contrast.reading: a stage that shows the contrast shows a within-person difference between the two tasks beyond the person's variation within either task, where the location part of the reference also does. It does not show that the difference is one of pause location: the tasks differ in text, in what is typed (copying mainly measures typing skill, Van Waes et al. 2021), in length, and in their place in one survey (the dataset numbers the copy task 1 and the essay task 2; the order is not otherwise stated), and all of these move the summaries. A stage below 0.60 where R_loc reads above shows the real difference less than the reference's location part does, by this distance and baseline, only if the paired difference's interval lies below 0 (paired_with_gate); an undecided cell is not read as below.
part_1_real_contrast.beside: descriptive, no label, in the same cells: (i) scale 'within': each feature divided by the square root of the mean of its two within-task variances (ddof 0, over the persons and the two parts of each task), so that the difference between the tasks does not widen the scale; (ii) change_all_pairs = the mean of the four distances essay A-copy A, essay A-copy B, essay B-copy A, essay B-copy B (main scale), so that the pairing is not a choice. Both use the main cell's persons and bootstrap indices.
part_1_real_contrast.paired_with_gate: descriptive: for each labelled and beside stage and cell, on the contrast rule persons, the difference of the per-person contributions (1, 1/2, 0) of the stage and of R_loc, its mean (= the difference of the two shares) with a 95% percentile interval over the same 2000 resamples (the same indices for both). A stage below 0.60 where R_loc is above shows the difference less than R_loc does on these persons only if this interval lies below 0; otherwise the two are not told apart.

part_2_doses.cells: KUPA essay and LWP; odd/even and halves; families inside_p and cross_p; steps 25, 50, 100: 24 cells per stage, counted on rule persons (stage and R) with R, R_loc and R_lag on the same persons.
part_2_doses.reported: per cell and stage, the share and interval and its class (above, below, undecided against 0.60) and the paired difference with R_loc (as part 1's paired_with_gate, on the same persons and indices); per family, dataset, baseline and stage, the first of the three steps at which the stage reads above 0.60 ('none' if none does), and the same for R_loc; whether the share rises with the step (25 <= 50 <= 100). Beside each step, what actually moved (rows.tallies). Cells fixed by construction (inside_p for U@2000, U_med and B@2000) are named, their shares follow v6k's tie rule and are not read.
part_2_doses.reading: descriptive, no label. 'The first step at which it reads above 0.60' is a statement about these three steps on one random plan per person, not an amount needed. A stage whose first step is above R_loc's needs more of the operation than the reference's location part does on those persons, at these steps; a stage that reads no step above 0.60 where R_loc reads one does not show that much of the move by this distance and baseline. The steps are shares of the eligible sentences or gaps of each person, not amounts of time moved (the time moved is reported beside); the doses are nested within a person, so the cells of a family are not independent, and a share that does not rise with the step is reported as such.

part_3_U_med: descriptive: U_med in every count 1 cell (gate 0 and rule persons), in the 12 main cells beside v6k's rule, and in the contrast cells. Read beside U@2000: whether leaving out the two IQRs changes the class of a cell.

part_4_signed.what: per person, on the whole-record vector (all sentences as one part; the stage's numbers unscaled, in their own units), the signed change per feature: essay - copy (contrast persons) and row - text for inside/before, shuffled/before, shuffled_in_halves/before, random_half and the six dose rows (count 1 persons of KUPA essay and LWP with the vector in both). Stages: U@2000 (4), B@2000, Bsd@2000, I (3), R_loc (6), R_lag, B_complete@2000.
part_4_signed.reported: per set, row, stage and feature: n; first, the shares of persons with a change above 1e-9, below -1e-9 and between (in the feature's own units; every feature here is a log time, a share, a correlation, a count of presses or seconds, so 1e-9 is far below its resolution and catches only exact zeros and rounding); then the median over persons with a 95% percentile interval over 2000 bootstrap resamples of persons (numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 97, dataset, task, stage index, row index, feature index]); the contrast uses row index 13). A set with fewer than 5 persons is not written; a non-finite value stops the run.
part_4_signed.reading: descriptive: the direction at the level of the group is read from the shares of the signs (for example 'the change was positive in 83% of persons'); a median whose interval excludes 0 is reported beside, not as consistency across persons and not as a test of a hypothesis (many correlated features, no correction). It is reported beside count 1, which judges each person against their own parts and has no direction.

checks.reuse: before the new persons are counted, and stopping the run otherwise: on v6k's persons (KUPA essay and LWP), the rule persons' counts in the 12 main cells (persons, share_vs_own and its interval) of U@2000, B@2000, Bsd@2000 and I, with R and R_loc on their persons, equal v6l's record (v6l's keys, starting 90), and the labels under gates R and R_loc equal v6l's.
checks.rows: per person: inside_100's gaps equal inside/before's; the swaps of inside_25 are a subset of inside_50's and those of inside_50 of inside_100's; the same for cross_p; every row's gaps are a permutation of the text's.
checks.construction: the identities of stages.by_construction per person (|change| <= 1e-9), and v6k's (at 2 s) under inside/before and shuffled_in_halves/before.
checks.missing: a count over fewer than 2 persons is too_few_persons (as v6k) and not read; a summary over fewer than 5 values is not written; a label is written for every labelled stage whatever its persons (with 'not evaluable' when fewer than 4 cells are read).

prediction: Claude's, written before running. P1: on the new persons, the part 0 labels under gate R equal v6k's for U@2000 and B@2000 ('does not show them beyond it') and for I ('mixed directions'), and Bsd@2000's is 'not beyond, partly undecided' or 'does not show them beyond it'. P2: in part 1, R_loc reads all 4 contrast cells above 0.60. P3: in part 1, U@2000 and I are labelled 'shows these operations beyond the smallest difference'. P4: in part 1, B@2000 reads at least 2 of its 4 cells above 0.60. P5: in part 2, R_loc in LWP reads inside_100 above 0.60 under both baselines and inside_25 under neither. P6: in part 2, R_loc reads cross_100 above 0.60 in all 4 of its cells (2 sets, 2 baselines), I in all 4, and U@2000 in at least 2. P7: U_med reads none of the 8 shuffle main cells above 0.60 (gate 0). P8: in part 4, the median essay - copy of U's median ln short gap is above 0 with its interval above 0. No value of v6m had been seen.
main_cells: fixed before running, shown first: part 0's labels under gates R and R_loc beside v6k's; part 1's labels with the 4 cells of each stage and of R_loc; part 2's table of classes per step for R_loc, U@2000, B@2000, Bsd@2000 and I; then part 3, part 4 and the rest in the order of this file.

record.public: results/prototype_v6m/record.json: counts and summaries over persons and the provenance; no press time, gap, key, text, per-person vector, per-person value, per-person change or id (ids only as the SHA-256 of their sorted list); a summary over fewer than 5 values is not written (v6l). The data are not redistributed.
record.provenance: git commit and dirty state of the conditions, code and lock; SHA-256 of the conditions, the earlier conditions and records, the code and the data; versions.

limits_written_before: Part 0 recounts v6k's rule on new persons with a procedure, rows and gate chosen on earlier persons; one recount is not a test of the procedure's validity. Part 1's difference is not an operation: the two tasks differ in text, content (copying mainly measures typing skill), length and place in one survey; a summary that shows it may show typing speed rather than pause location, and the procedure cannot tell them apart. The pairing of copy A with essay A is a choice (change_all_pairs beside); the main scale pools both tasks, so features in which the tasks differ most are scaled down (scale 'within' beside). The parts differ in what they hold (halves: the time course of a task; odd/even: local variation) and in length; the lengths of the two tasks are not matched. Part 2's steps are shares of a person's sentences or long sentence-initial gaps, not of time; inside_p moves short gaps as well as long ones; cross_p moves a long gap both out of its sentence and into another, so U and B see a change of which sentences hold long time, not only of where in a sentence. Parts 2-4 are descriptions; many correlated cells. Signed medians are of whole-record vectors in raw units; they are not effect sizes of a design. Only the 2 s threshold is counted. A share shows sensitivity of a summary to a difference in press times; it says nothing about the cognitive meaning of a pause or the quality of a text.
rerun_rule: as v6k: if a defect of the code is found after the first run, the first record is kept unchanged, the fix and the reason are committed, and the rerun is reported separately beside the first.
generator: as v6k (checked by v6k's code against v6k's conditions).
